texto_inicial: EX-99.1 2 a8-kex991q3202606272026.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Apple reports third quarter results June quarter records for total company revenue and EPS iPhone, Mac and Services revenue set new June quarter records CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple ® today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 third quarter ended June 27, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16 percent year over year. Company gross margin was 50.1 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 2 percentage points from tariff refunds.
